title: 第1章 围殴第2章 隐脉
slug: 剑道狂神第4623章一枚令牌
lines: 天圣大陆，天龙帝国，落星森林外围。
划过一声凄厉的惨叫。
唐天感觉脑袋猛地遭受了一道重击，钻心的疼，痛入骨髓。
数息工夫，那痛感就如同电击一般，瞬间传达到了全身。
唐天忍不住惨叫一声！
一张肥头大耳，惨不忍睹的肉脸。
正露出狰狞又残忍的笑意！
“靠，这什么玩意？”
那张脸凑得太近，唐天被吓了一跳，想都没想一拳打了过去。
“啊，该死！”
对方捂着眼睛，发出了比杀猪还凄厉的惨叫。
猝不及防下，他的眼睛被一拳打的充血，变得更加丑陋不堪。
“居然还没死，一个炼脉境的废物，还敢打老子！”
胖脸的主人，是一位十五岁左右的少年。
身旁还围着三个少年，怒吼不已。
“还敢还手？教他做人！
其中一个獐头鼠目的少年，扯着尖细的嗓子喊道。
不等唐天反应过来，脸上便重重的挨了一拳，一道鲜血顺着嘴角流了出来。
脚下一个踉跄，直接趴在了地上。
唐天闷哼一声，肚子上又结实的挨了一脚，整个人好像要散架了一般。
接着被踢飞出去，撞在了一棵大树上，树叶落满了全身，狼狈不堪，脸都痛的扭曲起来。
唐天知道自己刚重生过来，却在遭受毒打。
还是被围殴的那种！
“混蛋！”
唐天咬着牙，费力的爬了起来。
“孙子航，你小子先前明明打死了他，现在这个废物怎么还能站起来？”
胖子见到唐天挣扎着站了起来，非常不满，开口咆哮！
之前众人将“唐天”
谎骗到落星森林，来到这偏僻的角落，就是下了死手。
众人都以为已经打死了“唐天”
content_en:
Tiansheng Continent, Tianlong Empire, and the outskirts of Falling Star Forest.
There was a shrill scream.
Tang Tian felt a heavy blow to his head, a heartbreaking pain that penetrated to his bones.
Within a few breaths, the pain was like an electric shock, instantly transmitted to the whole body.
"Ah!"
Tang Tian couldn't help but scream!
A fat head, big ears, and a hideous fleshy face.
He was showing a ferocious and cruel smile!
"Damn, what the hell is this?"
The face was so close that Tang Tian was startled and punched him without thinking.
"Ah, damn!"
The other party covered his eyes and let out a scream that was more horrifying than a slaughtered pig.
Caught off guard, his eyes were bloodshot and became even more ugly.
"He's not dead yet. A waste in the Pulse Refining Realm dares to hit me!"
The owner of the fat face is a boy about fifteen years old.
There were three teenagers surrounding him, roaring angrily.
"You dare to fight back? Teach him how to behave!
On! "
One of the young men with a deer head and rat eyes shouted in a high-pitched voice.
Before Tang Tian could react, he received a heavy punch in the face, and a stream of blood flowed out from the corner of his mouth.
He stumbled and fell directly to the ground.
"Uh..."
Tang Tian groaned and received another strong kick in the stomach, as if his whole body was about to fall apart.
Then he was kicked out and hit a big tree. Leaves fell all over his body. He was in a miserable state and his face was twisted in pain.
"Fuck!"
Tang Tian knew that he had just been reborn, but was being beaten severely.
Still the kind that got beaten up!
"Asshole!"
Tang Tian gritted his teeth and climbed up with great effort.
"Sun Tzu Hang, your kid clearly beat him to death before, how can this loser still stand up now?"
When the fat man saw Tang Tian struggling to stand up, he was very dissatisfied and roared!
Before, everyone called "Tang Tian"
He lied to Luo Xing Forest and came to this remote corner to kill him.
Everyone thought they had killed "Tang Tian"
